title: Hearty Herbal Canadian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Canadian dish featuring lamb, palm sugar, and herbs, cooked to perfection in a traditional clay tajine, perfect for a midnight craving. This whole30-friendly recipe is a hearty and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the palm sugar, olive oil, rosemary, thyme, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Place the lamb pieces in the clay tajine and brush the sugar and herb mixture evenly over the lamb.
Cover the tajine with parchment paper and then with aluminum foil, creating a papillote effect.
Place the tajine in the oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the foil and parchment paper and continue cooking for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the tajine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
